segments.text: As a matter of fact, I do.
I'm allowed to have plans on my birthday.
Yeah, isn't that strange? It's the same day as last year.
Oh, it was very nice. Very tasteful. Thank you, Mr. Stark.
I would like a, a vodka martini, please. Very dry with olives. A lot of olives. Like at least three olives.
I've got your clothes here. They've been dry cleaned and pressed, and there's a car waiting for you outside that will take you anywhere you'd like to go.
I do anything and everything that Mr. Stark requires, including occasionally taking out the trash. Will that be all?

note: Speaker attribution from the supplied dialogue screenshots; boundaries from local Parakeet word timing. Short stutter in olives is retained in the reference transcript.
